{"answer":"Yes, the reporting was consistent. The Sporting News report on November 6, 2023, stated that Jim Harbaugh was suspended for three games and would be without their coach on the sidelines in Happy Valley [1]. The November 11, 2023, report confirmed that Harbaugh did not coach against Penn State, with reports noting he was not on the bus with the team [4] and that Sherrone Moore filled in as acting coach [8]. The evidence consistently indicates Harbaugh was absent from the sidelines for the Penn State game due to the suspension, with no conflicting reports in the provided evidence. The evidence also notes that Harbaugh was allowed to coach during the week but not on the sideline [3], and that Michigan did not get a ruling on a temporary restraining order ahead of the game [3]. Thus, the reporting on Harbaugh's absence was consistent across the two reports.
